title: E-Administration: Ügyfélkapu+, Algorithmic Decision-Making and Rights

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Hungary has shifted toward comprehensive e-administration: the *Ügyfélkapu+* (Client Gate+, which replaced the older *Ügyfélkapu* in January 2025) and the *Digitális Állampolgárság Program (DÁP)* offer online channels beside the paper queues. These are present-day systems, and names and procedures change often.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Digital administration can bring efficiency, but also new legal challenges: algorithmic bias, cybersecurity vulnerabilities, and the *digitális szakadék* (digital divide) affecting the elderly and rural populations.
